T3_about.h2: What Geenius System is and who it is for
T3_about.text: Geenius System is a Bio-Rad platform for automated reading and interpretation of individual HIV-1, HIV-2, and HCV assays. It supports confirmation and differentiation of HIV-1 and HIV-2 antibodies as well as supplemental HCV testing. The system suits laboratories of different sizes that need automated interpretation of individual assay strips, a detailed report with a cassette image, and result transfer to an LIS.

items.text: The software evaluates individual cassette bands and automatically produces a patient-status conclusion using the manufacturer's algorithms. The detailed report includes a cassette image.
Geenius automatically calibrates the reader and checks lot validation. These checks are built into the system workflow before results are produced.
Results can be securely archived and transferred to an LIS through a bidirectional interface. The laboratory receives the system-generated conclusion and cassette image.

items.q: Which assays is Geenius System intended for?
items.a: It supports confirmation and differentiation of HIV-1 and HIV-2 antibodies and supplemental HCV testing.

items.q: How does Geenius System interpret a result?
items.a: It automatically evaluates individual cassette bands and produces a conclusion using the manufacturer's algorithms. The report includes a cassette image.

items.q: Can Geenius System send results to an LIS?
items.a: Yes. The system supports bidirectional data exchange with an LIS.

items.q: Who supplies Geenius System in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is a Bio-Rad partner and supplier in Ukraine, providing supply, installation, staff training, and service support.
